meta.name: minimalist-ui
meta.description: Clean editorial-style interfaces. Warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels. No gradients, no heavy shadows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建干净、编辑风格的界面设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要简洁、温暖、无阴影的界面风格。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clean, warm, shadowless interface style.

howto.what: 写前端代码或设计页面时,Claude 会按编辑式极简风格产出界面:暖色单色调、排版对比、扁平 bento 网格、低饱和柔和色,不用渐变与重阴影。
howto.when: 当你让它写前端代码(HTML、React、Tailwind 等)或设计页面布局时,这个技能会接管,并按里面的规范生成代码。

say.text: 用这套极简风格做一个产品落地页。
say.note: 会输出暖色单色调 + bento 网格的代码。

say.text: 把这个页面改成编辑式排版,去掉所有渐变和阴影。
say.note: 会替换字体层级并按无阴影规则改写。

say.text: 给我一个带低饱和标签和扁平按钮的定价区块。
say.note: 标签用柔和色,按钮无阴影、小圆角。

howto.what_en: When writing frontend code or layouts, Claude produces editorial-style minimalist interfaces: warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids and muted pastels, with no gradients and no heavy shadows.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to write frontend code (HTML, React, Tailwind, etc.) or design a page layout; it then follows the protocol's rules for that build.

say_en.text: Build a product landing page in this minimalist style.
say_en.note: Outputs code with warm monochrome and bento grids.

say_en.text: Rework this page with editorial typography and drop all gradients and shadows.
say_en.note: Swaps type hierarchy and applies the no-shadow rules.

say_en.text: Give me a pricing section with muted pastel tags and flat buttons.
say_en.note: Pastel tags, small-radius buttons, no shadow.
